subject: kiwad_archive_inventory
claim: On revision r806919.Wizard_1_610, all 3,599 .wad archives in the submitter's install contain 550,749 entries with 19,603,697,543 stored payload bytes and 34,582,846,135 declared uncompressed bytes.
how_to_repeat: On an unchanged r806919.Wizard_1_610 install, enumerate every .wad recursively from the install root without starting Wizard101 or its launcher.

Read each archive's table of contents, all integers little-endian: the KIWAD magic at offset 0, a u32 version at offset 5, a u32 entry count at offset 9, one flag byte when the version is 2 or higher, then for each entry 21 bytes of fields, a u32 data offset, a u32 size, a u32 compressed size, one compressed byte, a u32 CRC and a u32 name length, followed by the name.

For every entry, count one file, add its compressed size to stored_bytes when its compressed byte is set and its size otherwise, add its size to uncompressed_bytes, and add its compressed size to compressed_payload_bytes and one to compressed_file_count only when its compressed byte is set; take archive_bytes from the file's length, and compare the per-archive table and aggregate totals in this finding.
evidence: The recursive scan found 3,599 unique .wad paths, all under Data/GameData; the same number was returned by a separate filesystem enumeration.
Ambrose KiwadHeader::Parse accepted all 3,599 archives with default bounds checks enabled; every archive used KIWAD version 1.
The parsed tables contained 550,749 entries; their GetStoredSize() values sum to 19,603,697,543 bytes, compressed entries contribute 11,947,196,807 bytes, and Size values sum to 34,582,846,135 bytes.
The physical archive file lengths sum to 19,644,066,226 bytes, matching the independent filesystem size total.

A second observation on another r806919.Wizard_1_610 install, by a table-of-contents reader written independently from the layout above, found 3,589 archives, all under Data/GameData; every one is a row of this finding with the same file count, stored, compressed and uncompressed bytes, archive bytes and compressed file count, and every one is KIWAD version 1.

That install lacks ten of this finding's archives, all under Data/GameData: Avalon-Interiors-AV_Z03_EstateFroudling.wad, DragonSpire-DS_A1_Knowledge-Interiors-DS_GrandChasm_T4.wad, Empyrea-Interiors-EM_Z04_FireDwarfHouse.wad, MooShu-MS_War-Interiors-MS_War2_T4.wad, WizardCity-WC_Streets-Interiors-WC_Colossus_CE_T1_L1.wad, WizardCity-WC_Streets-Interiors-WC_Colossus_CE_T1_L2.wad, WizardCity-WC_Streets-Interiors-WC_Colossus_CE_T1_L3.wad, WizardCity-WC_Streets-Interiors-WC_Colossus_CE_T1_L4.wad, WizardCity-WC_Streets-Interiors-WC_Colossus_CE_T1_L5.wad and WizardCity-WC_Streets-Interiors-WC_Colossus_CE_T1_L6.wad; its PatchInfo folder lists none of the ten, neither as a CRC_<name>.dat file nor in LatestFileList.bin.
disproof: A repeat of the table-of-contents census on another r806919.Wizard_1_610 install that finds different per-archive entry or byte totals for an archive both installs hold, or cannot parse such an archive's table of contents, refutes this inventory.
size_semantics: stored_bytes sums KiwadEntry::GetStoredSize(): CompressedSize for compressed entries and Size otherwise; compressed_payload_bytes sums only CompressedSize for entries marked compressed; uncompressed_bytes sums Size for all entries; archive_bytes is the physical .wad file length.
